text:
mira: quick postmortem follow-up: recurring theme = rollouts that expand too fast + no short-circuit rollback. need owners, short timelines, and one synthetic to prove rollback works.

jon: i can own a minimal rollback API (idempotent + emits audit events). plan: prototype in 5 days, unit tests w/ audit stream.

tz: i'll take policy enforcement for blast-radius limits at the gateway (default caps, soft overrides with TTL). will draft schema by mid-week.

ci-bot: note: recent monitor found 6 flags >15% exposure in last 90 days. see /alerts/flags/exposure.

mira: proposal summary:
- rollback API: toggle flag + optional traffic-shift to last-known-good pool
- automatic triggers: error_rate spike, latency P95 jump, model-quality regression metric
- enforcement: default route cap 5% (hard), org cap 12% (soft, approver TTL)
- ops: one-click verification link + checklist for oncall

jon: sample endpoint idea:
POST /internal/rollback {"flag":"ranker-v3","target":"stable","initiator":"automation"} -> returns {audit_id}

tz: policy snippet (draft):
policy "exposure" { route: "*/rerank" cap: 0.05 soft: true approvers: ["platform-lead"] }

anya: ops needs: 1) verification URL returned by the rollback call, 2) checklist with exact metric queries, 3) TTL on manual overrides. i'll own the runbook edits.

mira: action items (owners + rough due dates):
- A1: rollback API + audit stream (owner: jon) 9due: 2024-06-07
- A2: gateway cap enforcement + schema (owner: tz) 9due: 2024-06-03
- A3: one-click verification link + runbook snippet (owner: anya) 9due: 2024-05-30
- A4: synthetic rollback CI job (owner: jon + infra) 9due: 2024-06-10
- A5: weekly dashboard for high-exposure flags + quarterly audit job (owner: mira) 9due: 2024-06-17

jon: acceptance checklist i'll add to A1: idempotent behavior, audit_id in kinesis, e2e that triggers rollback via synthetic metric.

tz: acceptance for A2: schema unit tests, negative tests for override TTL, enforcement metric showing caps applied.

ci-bot: scheduled synthetic rollback test: 2242003550 (staging) 9run: smoke + verification URL.

mira: please attach acceptance criteria to tickets before EOD. i'll track progress on the postmortem follow-up board and bring updates to next SRE sync.

jon: i'll open the tickets and link this thread. thanks all. :thumbsup:
